description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 14 March 2025, made for sealed play, with the Trainer's Pokémon of Ethan, Misty, Cynthia and Arven. Ethan's Ho-Oh ex, Cynthia's Garchomp ex and Arven's Mabosstiff ex lead it, with Ethan's Typhlosion, Misty's Gyarados, Cynthia's Roserade and Trainer cards such as Ethan's Adventure, Cynthia's Power Weight and Arven's Sandwich, and Sacred Ash. Yanmega ex, Dondozo ex and Electivire ex join them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 63, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Ultra Rare Ethan's Ho-Oh ex, Cynthia's Garchomp ex and Levincia. In English most of its cards came out in Destined Rivals in May 2025.
